name: usage-ledger-estimate-path
title: Implement LLM usage ledger Slice 3: preflight estimate path (count_tokens-preferred, confidence-ranked, model-bound) — pure, pluggable, not wired to live providers
description: Third implementation slice of the LLM usage ledger (spec docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md; foundation B-253e, adapters B-08a1). Build the PURE preflight estimate path in packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/, keeping the module's zero-cross-module-coupling property: the actual provider count_tokens HTTP call is a PLUGGABLE injected interface (wired in the later dispatch slice), and this slice provides only the orchestration + deterministic local fallbacks. Deliverables: (1) an estimator interface + confidence model — EstimatorKind (count_tokens | local_tokenizer | bytes_chars) mapped to confidence (count_tokens=high, local_tokenizer=medium, bytes_chars=low); a TokenEstimator type = an (optionally async) function (model, text|promptParts) -> estimated input-token count; (2) deterministic OFFLINE local fallback estimator(s) — a bytes/chars heuristic (low confidence); explicitly NOT tiktoken (wrong for Claude); no network, no provider client; (3) an estimate selector that, given an optional injected count_tokens estimator plus the local fallbacks, picks the best available (count_tokens > local_tokenizer > bytes_chars), records which estimator was used (name, version, unit, confidence), and binds the estimate to the exact model id (counts are model-version-specific); (4) buildEstimateRecord(model, promptParts|estimatedInput, correlation, attribution, estimatorResult) producing a usage.source='prompt-size-estimate' record that passes the B-253e validator (estimator.{name,version,unit} required; estimated count in canonical.input; output/cache dimensions null=unknown since nothing is generated yet) — reuse assemble.ts/record.ts/ids.ts in-module; (5) supersedes wiring so a later provider-reported final record can list the preflight estimate's recordId in supersedesRecordIds, and confirm the estimate NEVER counts as final usage (summary.ts already excludes superseded estimates); (6) a wired smoke. Out of scope: the real provider count_tokens HTTP binding (deferred to dispatch wiring), wiring into the live dispatch path, budget decision/enforcement, signed-receipt path, default-on. Keep all changes inside packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger (+ its smoke + package.json); do NOT couple to dispatch-runner/lattice-dispatch or any provider HTTP client.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the keyword token refers to LLM token counting (count_tokens / EstimatorKind / estimated input tokens), not auth/bearer/session/credential tokens. This slice is a pure preflight token-COUNT estimator; no secrets, keys, or auth involved. Confirmed by INIT story-init reviewer.
